text:
Carmen CSM: Quick heads-up 1 QuillWorks is hitting intermittent 429s in their staging environment during the partner workshop. They9re asking for a 90-minute QPS bump, plus an HMAC header + IP allowlist so their SSO test runners can finish the flow without auth retries.
Ibrahim NetOps: Copy. Need exact source IPs/CIDRs, HMAC header name and expected prefix, regions to route, start/end times, and whether to auto-revoke.
Carmen CSM: CIDRs: 198.51.104.16/28 (staging runners) and 203.0.113.250/32 (partner observer). HMAC header: X-QW-HMAC with prefix "qwh-". Regions: us-central1 primary, europe-west2 for observers. Window: 1.5 hours starting 14:30 CT. Auto-revoke: yes. Mark ticket renewal_flag:watch and cs_owner:Carmen.
Lena AM: This workshop is tied to a renewal decision in about 3 weeks. If the SSO test flakes they'll pause procurement. Please prioritize.
Ibrahim NetOps: I can add the CIDRs to ingress and whitelist the header prefix on the auth filter for that API key. Which key name will they use? Also, any sensitivity around logs (PII)?
Carmen CSM: Key: quill-staging-workshop-14-30. They asked that we not include SSO usernames in tickets; use pseudonyms in logs. Tag logs with customer:quillworks and session:staging-workshop-2026-06-01.
Toby Support: I'll stand up a short dashboard for 429/5xx and add annotations for the bump window. Thresholds: 429 > 1.5% or p95 latency > 900ms triggers an alert. Send me the key name so I can scope traces.
Rosa Eng: Quick suggestion: create a routing short-circuit for auth-health-check endpoints to a tiny handler so retries don't queue heavy generation. Proposed edge rule:
```
route:
  match: header.x-customer == "quillworks"
  policy:
    - name: staging-bump
      override_rate_limit: 9rps
      regions: [us-central1, europe-west2]
    - name: auth-health
      match_path: "/auth/hearts" # health-checks and token validation
      model: tiny-handler
      soft_qps: 20
```
Rosa Eng: That should keep SSO validation low-latency and avoid cascading 429s.
Ibrahim NetOps: Opening ticket and applying changes now. @OpsBot please create CS ticket with HMAC header allowlist and ingress CIDRs. ETA ~12m.
OpsBot: Created ticket CS-11011 1 Temporary QPS bump, HMAC header prefix allowlist, ingress CIDRs. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-11011
Ibrahim NetOps: Applied CIDRs and HMAC prefix allow on the staging key. Auto-revoke scheduled at 16:00 CT. Added metadata tags renewal_flag:watch cs_owner:Carmen. Will post peering IP if required for eu-west2.
Toby Support: Dashboards live and annotated CS-11011. I've scoped traces to key quill-staging-workshop-14-30. Pager if thresholds breach for 5m.
Lena AM: I'll be on the call for the workshop and will capture immediate NPS and any verbatim feedback on auth UX. Carmen 5 can you capture a short customer quote if they mention the retries?
Carmen CSM: Yes 1 will capture quotes and anonymize. Also please rotate the key after the window.
Rosa Eng: If you can send the failing request IDs and any sample auth payloads (anonymized), we can check for repeated prefixes and recommend prompt-level or header caching for the HMAC verification step. Could save a lot of compute.
Ibrahim NetOps: Peering ip reserved for europe-west2: 34.82.18.210. CS-11011 updated. Revert job scheduled at 16:00 CT.
Toby Support: Adding follow-up task: collect top 8 request ids that returned 429 with header X-QW-HMAC present and email to cs-evidence@redwood.com. I'll attach to CS-11011.
Lena AM: Note for renewal thread: success here will move QuillWorks from watch -> engaged. I'll update the playbook afterwards.
Carmen CSM: Checklist in-thread: [x] CIDRs added, [x] HMAC header prefix allowlist, [x] rate-window scheduled, [x] dashboards + alerts, [x] ticket CS-11011, [x] peering IP (eu-west2), [ ] post-workshop NPS + anonymized auth payloads.
Ibrahim NetOps: All changes applied and being monitored. Auto-revoke will run at 16:00 CT.
OpsBot: CS-11011 updated with revert job and monitoring annotations.
Toby Support: If the customer shares anonymized samples I'll attach them to the ticket and notify Rosa Eng for quick analysis.
Rosa Eng: Ready to run a quick sweep on samples and return caching/short-circuit suggestions within the day.
Carmen CSM: Thank you team 5 I'll post the post-workshop NPS and any quotes here once complete. :thumbsup:
